newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-BONALY TO MISS OUT ON WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-BONALY TO MISS OUT ON WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Five times European champion Surya Bonaly has failed to win a place in France's world championship team, the French figure skating federation said on Friday.
Bonaly, three times a world championship runner-up, failed to pass a test especially arranged for her after she finished only ninth in last month's European championships at Bercy.
France will be respresented in the women's event at the Lausanne world championships in March by Laetitia Hubert and Vanessa Gusmeroli.
